title: Financial Operations Specialist
description:
Seeking a highly detail-oriented Senior Financial Operations Specialist to take full ownership of end-to-end financial operations across benefit programs. This role is critical in ensuring financial integrity, accurate reporting, and scalable processes.



You will serve as the accountable owner of reconciliation, ledger accuracy, and financial process documentation, working closely with an external accounting firm initially. The ideal candidate operates with extreme autonomy, utilizing AI tools to drive efficiency and ensuring perfect GAAP compliance without management overhead. A key success metric for this role is the strategic transition of our client’s full bookkeeping and compliance function from external partners to internal ownership within your first year. 



The role is structured in two phases:

- Phase 1 (60–90 days): Historical backlog cleanup, reconciliation of past payments, resolution of discrepancies to establish a clean ledger, and process stabilization.

- Phase 2 (Ongoing): Weekly reconciliations, ledger maintenance, discrepancy investigation, continuous process improvement, and transition into expanded ownership of bookkeeping responsibilities



Key Responsibilities:

Financial Systems & Ledger Ownership

- Maintain a clean and accurate ledger, tracking approved benefit amounts, pending balances, payments, and precise timestamps.

- Reconcile payment records against approved benefit amounts on both a weekly and historical basis.

- Track and reconcile fund transfers to third-party payment partners against disbursement records.

- Take full ownership of the financial operations for the SLRA and TRS service lines, ensuring they run without constant management oversight.  

Compliance, Audit & Tax Control

- Ensure every outgoing payment is tied to an approved request and that all bank transfers maintain a complete audit trail.

- Manage all GAAP accounting standards and US tax compliance requirements, specifically focusing on 1099 filings.

- Perform deep-dive investigations into overpayments, underpayments, or missing payments to identify the root cause.

- Serve as the primary point of escalation for payment-related issues, resolving them internally before they reach clients or leadership.

Strategic Transition & Optimization

- Lead the 9-month transition to move all bookkeeping functions from the external accounting firm to internal ownership.  

- Identify and implement AI tools to automate manual reconciliation tasks and increase the efficiency of the finance function.  

- Build and maintain an "edge case library" that documents unique rules and handling scenarios to ensure consistent decision-making.

- Document and refine all financial processes to eliminate repeat decision-making and support future scalability.

Operational Support & Ad Hoc Analysis

- Assist with special reconciliations and reporting requests, ensuring high data integrity for all financial reporting.

- Participate in system clean-up initiatives and proactive process improvement exercises as assigned.

- Handle time-sensitive or non-standard requests from the finance or operations teams to support evolving business needs.



Requirements & Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (required; non-negotiable)

- Minimum 2 years of experience in Financial Operations, Reconciliation, AP/AR, or bookkeeping

- Strong attention to detail with a proactive ownership mindset; focused on root cause analysis, not just resolution

- Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including reconciliation tracking, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, and structured data logging

- Experience working with financial/transactional data, including bank statements, payment records, and general ledgers

- Strong written English skills for documenting processes, rules, and findings

- Experience with GAAP accounting and US tax compliance, including 1099 filing requirements (required)

- Experience with US companies or US accounting standards (required)

- Comfortable working in evolving environments and building processes from the ground up

- AI Proficiency: Must be "AI forward" and able to explain specifically how AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or specialized fintech AI) enhance their current role and efficiency. 

- Two professional references and a valid criminal background check issued within the last 60 days are required for all successful applicants.

- Completion of intake paperwork, including submission of a valid tax identification number (e.g., Social Security Number, Social Insurance Number, or the country’s equivalent), is required before onboarding.



Working Hours:

Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time



Pay: $1200+ $75 Allowance per month



NEXT STEPS:

: 

Subject line: Financial Operations Specialist



Also, kindly share your proficiency or years of experience with the following:

- Financial Operations 

- Reconciliation

- AP/AR

- US GAAP 

- US Tax Compliance 

- Excel (Advance Features/Formulas)

title: AI-Assisted Research + Development Writer
description:
Research + Development Writer



AI-Assisted Course Creation for Online Learning Platform



About the Role



We are looking for a thoughtful, detail-oriented Research + Development Writer to help us create high-quality online courses using AI tools.



You do not need to be an expert in coaching, psychology, business or education, although interest in these areas would be helpful.



Your main role will be to follow a clear step-by-step process using AI tools such as ChatGPT to research course topics, develop lesson structures, and turn ideas into clear, engaging video scripts and learning materials.



This is ideal for someone who enjoys learning new topics, working carefully with instructions, improving AI-generated content, and turning complex ideas into well-structured educational material.



About the Business



We are developing an AI-native education platform focused on coaching, philosophy and coaching business education.



The courses will be delivered using AI video faculty, supported by scripts, visual guides, reflection questions, worksheets and other learning resources.



Our aim is not to create cheap AI content. We want thoughtful, well-researched, beautifully structured learning experiences that feel intelligent, reflective and human.



Main Responsibilities



You will help create online courses by:



* Using AI tools to research course topics

* Following a step-by-step content development process

* Turning rough course ideas into structured outlines

* Developing module and lesson plans

* Creating clear video scripts for AI presenters

* Improving AI-generated drafts so they sound natural, thoughtful and useful

* Checking that ideas are explained clearly and logically

* Creating summaries, key points and reflection questions

* Helping develop worksheets, workbook sections and learner exercises

* Organising research notes and source material

* Following brand, tone and formatting guidelines

* Revising scripts based on feedback

* Helping build repeatable systems for course creation



What You Will Not Need to Do



You do not need to appear on camera.

You do not need to be a professional coach.

You do not need to be a business expert.

You do not need to create everything from scratch without guidance.



You will be given processes, prompts, examples and feedback. Your job is to use AI carefully and intelligently, then shape the results into strong educational content.



The Kind of Person We Are Looking For



You may be a good fit if you are:



A strong English writer

Curious and willing to learn unfamiliar topics

Comfortable using AI tools

Careful with detail

Good at following structured processes

Able to improve rough drafts

Able to organise complex information clearly

Patient, thoughtful and self-directed

Interested in education, psychology, coaching, leadership or personal development

Open to feedback and willing to revise work



Required Skills



* Excellent written English

* Experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools

* Strong research and summarising ability

* Good organisation skills

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Ability to turn information into clear, engaging scripts

* Reliable communication

* Good attention to detail



Helpful But Not Required



Experience or interest in any of the following would be useful:



* Online course creation

* Coaching or personal development

* Psychology or philosophy

* Business education

* Instructional design

* Copywriting

* YouTube scripts

* Academic research

* Notion, Google Docs or project management tools



Tools You May Use



You may work with tools such as:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Google Docs

* Google Drive

* Notion or similar project tools

* Research tools

* AI writing and editing tools



Training and guidance will be provided where needed.



Compensation



Starting pay: PHP 35,000 to PHP 40,000 per month, depending on experience, skill level and fit.



There is scope for growth over time as you become more skilled, take on more responsibility, and help improve the course creation process.



We are looking for someone who can grow with the business, not just complete short-term tasks.



Working Style



This is a remote role.



You will need to be comfortable working independently, following written instructions, and communicating clearly about progress, questions and challenges.



The work will usually involve moving through a structured process from:



1. Course concept

2. AI-assisted research

3. Course outline

4. Module structure

5. Lesson script

6. Reflection questions

7. Workbook or worksheet content

8. Review and revision



Example Tasks



A typical task might be:



* Research a topic using AI and provided sources

* Create a structured course outline

* Draft a 1,500-word video lesson script

* Rewrite the script to make it clearer and more engaging

* Create 5 reflection questions for learners

* Create a short summary of the key ideas

* Format everything neatly in Google Docs



Important Qualities



The most important qualities for this role are not subject-matter expertise.



They are:



* Clear thinking

* Good writing

* Careful use of AI

* Willingness to follow a process

* Curiosity

* Reliability

* Taste and judgement



We want someone who can help turn AI-generated material into something much better: clearer, deeper, more useful and more human.



How to Apply



Please apply with:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your writing or research experience

3. Your experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools

4. Why this role interests you

5. A sample of your writing, if available



Please also answer this question:



How would you use AI to help research and write a course script while still making sure the final result is clear, accurate and useful?

title: Creative Project Assistant

I will provide the creative direction, references, and feedback. Your job is to help execute the workflow carefully, systematically, and with strong attention to detail.

* Using AI image generation tools to create image options and variations

* Removing backgrounds and cleaning up image edges

* Cropping, resizing, exporting, and renaming image files correctly

* Background removal

You do not need to be a senior graphic designer. However, you should have good visual judgement and be able to prepare clean, organised, usable files.



Requirements

* Strong visual attention to detail

* Good taste and basic understanding of design theory

* Basic image editing skills

* Good file organisation habits

* Good written English

* Ability to follow detailed instructions carefully

* Ability to compare images and spot small differences

* Comfort using AI tools or willingness to learn quickly

* Reliable, organised, and systematic working style

* Patience for repetitive visual QC, editing, and file preparation work



Preferred Background

* Art

* Design

* Illustration

* Animation

* Visual communication

* Graphic design

* Fashion

* Media

* Photography

* Architecture

Tools You May Use

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Canva

* Figma

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Background removal tools

* Other AI image or editing tools



You do not need to know every tool already, but you should be able to learn new tools quickly.



What This Role Is



This role is for someone who enjoys visual production, organisation, and careful execution.



You will help generate, edit, compare, organise, and prepare creative assets. A big part of the role is making sure images match the provided character and style references, and that final files are clean, properly named, and ready to use.



What This Role Is Not



This is not a senior creative director role.

This is not a pure admin virtual assistant role.

This is not a pure graphic design role.

This is not just prompt writing.

This is not a strategy role.



This is a mixed creative support role focused on AI image generation, visual QC, light Adobe production, file preparation, and organised execution**.

Creative Project Assistant Application

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: Full-Stack Developer / AI-Assisted Product Engineer
description:
# Full-Stack Developer / AI-Assisted Product Engineer



## Job Type



Full-time or long-term part-time

Remote

Long-term position for the right person



## About the Role



I am looking for a smart, reliable, detail-oriented software developer from the Philippines who can help build real business software products from idea to working application.



This is not just a basic coding job. I am looking for someone who can think like a product engineer: understand requirements, ask good questions, build clean features, test their own work, and use AI tools intelligently to move faster.



You will work directly with me on software projects for businesses. Many of the projects involve internal business systems, dashboards, admin portals, automation tools, AI-assisted workflows, reporting tools, customer portals, and integrations.



The ideal person is someone who is very comfortable learning, solving problems, and using modern AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar development assistants.



## Responsibilities



You may help with:



* Building web applications from requirements

* Frontend development using Angular, React, or similar frameworks

* Backend development using ASP.NET Core, Node.js, or similar backend frameworks

* Working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL

* Creating clean APIs

* Building admin panels, dashboards, forms, workflows, and reporting pages

* Writing unit tests, integration tests, and basic end-to-end tests

* Debugging and fixing issues

* Reading existing codebases and understanding how they work

* Using AI tools to speed up development while still verifying the output

* Writing simple technical documentation and handoff notes

* Helping turn business requirements into clear software features



## Required Skills



You should have experience with at least the following:



* JavaScript / TypeScript

* Angular, React, or Vue

* ASP.NET Core

* REST APIs

* SQL databases

* Git / GitHub

* HTML, CSS, responsive UI

* Playwright, Cypress, or other testing tools

* Experience with AI coding tools

* Debugging and problem solving

* Good written English

* Ability to explain what you built and why



## Nice to Have



These are not required, but they are a big plus:



* NodeJS

* Angular

* PostgreSQL or SQL Server

* Entity Framework Core

* Experience building SaaS products

* Experience with business software, CRM, ERP, inventory, accounting, ecommerce, or reporting systems

* WordPress experience

* Basic DevOps / deployment knowledge



## What I Am Looking For



I care more about intelligence, honesty, and problem-solving ability than perfect credentials.



You should be:



* Very reliable

* Honest about what you know and do not know

* Good at communicating progress

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear

* Careful with details

* Interested in long-term work

* Willing to learn new tools and frameworks

* Able to test your own work before saying it is done



## Important



Please do not apply if you only copy and paste AI-generated code without understanding it.



AI tools are welcome and encouraged, but you must be able to review the code, fix problems, explain your work, and make sure the final result actually works.



## Work Style



You will receive clear tasks, requirements, and acceptance criteria. For larger tasks, you may be asked to help break down requirements, identify missing questions, and suggest better ways to build the product.



I prefer someone who can give daily updates, communicate clearly, and show working progress often.



## Hours



Flexible schedule is okay, but I need consistent availability and reliable communication.



Please include your preferred schedule and how many hours per week you are available.



## Compensation



Please include your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in your application.



I am looking for a long-term working relationship. If you are talented, reliable, and improve over time, there will be room to grow.



## How to Apply



When applying, please answer these questions:



1. What is your experience with frontend development? Which framework do you know best?

2. What is your experience with backend development?

3. What databases have you worked with?

4. Have you used AI coding tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools? If yes, how do you use them?

5. Describe the most complex software project you have worked on.

6. Send links to your GitHub, portfolio, or previous work if available.

7. What is your expected hourly rate or monthly salary?

8. How many hours per week are you available?

9. What is your internet speed and computer setup?

10. In one paragraph, explain how you would approach building a simple customer order management system with login, customers, orders, order statuses, and an admin dashboard.



Please start your application with the words: **“Product Engineer Applicant”** so I know you read the full post.

title: Quickbase Developer

title: CPA US Tax Preparer (Lacerte Tax Software)
description:
Our client, a US-based public accounting firm, is hiring a remote Tax Preparer (CPA) to prepare and review individual, business, and trust tax returns in full compliance with federal and state tax regulations. This is a hands-on preparer seat — you will own returns from source-document intake through reviewer handoff and e-file, working directly inside Lacerte tax software.



This role is built for a tax professional who has already logged real public accounting cycles: someone who can open a prior-year 1120S, reconcile to current-year trial balance, identify the M-1 adjustments, allocate K-1 items correctly, run Lacerte diagnostics, and prepare a clean workpaper file the reviewer can sign off on without rework. You'll communicate directly with US clients to request missing documents, explain results, and respond to filing questions, so written and verbal English fluency is non-negotiable.



The team operates remote-first with async-default communication. During US peak season (February through April 15, plus the September–October extension window), return volume scales significantly and deadline discipline becomes the differentiator between candidates who succeed and candidates who don't. Outside of peak, the work shifts toward tax planning support, estimated tax calculations, projections, and notice response.



You will report to a US-based reviewer or tax manager. Success at 90 days means your returns pass first-round review with minimal diagnostics, your client communication is professional and timely, and your workpaper documentation is organized enough that any reviewer can pick up your file mid-engagement.



Responsibilities



Tax Preparation & Filing



Prepare federal and state returns for Form 1040, Form 1120, Form 1120S, Form 1065, and Form 1041

Enter financial data accurately into Lacerte from source documents and trial balances

Review prior-year returns and roll forward carryovers, basis, and depreciation schedules

Identify deductions, credits, and tax planning opportunities

Ensure compliance with current federal and state tax law, including any mid-year regulatory changes

Client Communication



Request missing documentation from clients with clear, itemized requests

Explain tax results, balances due, and refund positions in plain language

Respond to IRS and state notices and routine filing questions

Maintain professional client service standards in all written correspondence

Quality Control & Review



Self-review returns and clear Lacerte diagnostics before submission to reviewer

Resolve discrepancies and review comments promptly

Stay current on federal and multi-state tax law changes throughout the year

Documentation & File Management

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

• Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

• Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

• Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

• Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

• Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

• Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

• Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

• Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

• Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

• Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

• Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

• Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS:

Schedule Flexible / output-based — strict deadlines apply

Onboarding Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.

We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.

And we’re just getting started.

As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?



-This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: UK Construction - Finance Assistant
description:
FINANCE ASSISTANT



Smith & Sons Construction Services Ltd | Remote | Part-Time (25 hours per week)

ABOUT SSCS

Smith & Sons Construction Services Ltd (SSCS) is a premium residential construction company operating across East London, Havering and Essex. We are a director-led business building a strong, systems-driven foundation, and we are looking for an experienced finance professional to take ownership of our day-to-day finances as we grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced, UK-construction-literate virtual Finance Assistant to take ownership of our bookkeeping, reconciliation, reporting and supplier payments.

The role begins by taking financial administration off the directors' desks. Over time - as you learn our systems and prove the core role can be done efficiently - it expands into higher-value finance work. We are looking for someone who can support the business for the long term, and the role is genuinely open to growing and being shaped around the right individual. The right person is meticulous, proactive and able to turn numbers into clear insight the directors can act on.

This is a finance-first role, and the construction finance knowledge is non-negotiable.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Bookkeeping and reconciliation (the core of the role)





Own our dedicated accounts inbox and manage the working relationship with our external accounting and bookkeeping team - resolving their weekly queries and, more importantly, working to prevent those queries by keeping the books clean in the first place.

Process all purchase invoices through Dext: ensure each is correctly tagged to the right project, the correct cost category is applied, and - critically - the correct VAT treatment is used, including the construction VAT domestic reverse charge where it applies.

Stay alert to duplication. For example, where a director has photographed and uploaded an over-the-counter invoice that also arrives by
, verify the entry rather than relying solely on Dext and Xero's duplicate detection.

Reconcile all company bank accounts and credit cards in Xero on an ongoing basis.

Administer the Construction Industry Scheme (CIS): verify subcontractors, apply the correct deductions, and prepare and file the monthly CIS return through Xero.





Reporting and insight





Produce project-level reporting on all active jobs: total contract value against amount invoiced and amount remaining, cost-to-date split across labour, materials and subcontractors, and overall project profitability - in effect, cost-value reconciliation (CVR) and work-in-progress (WIP) tracking - flagging any cash flow risks early.

Produce business-level reporting: regular profit and loss, cash position and forecasts, so the directors always know where the business stands.

Treat cash flow forecasting as a distinct discipline, not just historical reporting.

Deliver a structured update to the directors at least once a week in a scheduled video meeting, with shorter interim updates to a director by WhatsApp as needed. Translating the numbers into plain, actionable insight is central to this role.





Client invoicing, credit control and supplier payments





Manage client billing through Xero, including stage-payment and repeating-invoice schedules. Help design billing schedules that keep projects cash-flow-positive for SSCS - particularly on larger contracts, where a flat weekly figure no longer fits and billing needs to track progress and applications for payment so the business is not funding the build ahead of being paid.

Raise client invoices and chase outstanding payments (credit control).

Run the weekly supplier payment cycle through a payment-approval system: identify bills that are due and not yet paid, enter all the details required to pay them (amount, invoice, reference and payee bank details), and present the week's payment run to the directors as a report. Directors review and approve line by line; approved payments release on the weekly cycle.



The assistant prepares payments; the directors authorise them. This separation is a deliberate financial control and a fixed boundary of the role.

HOW THE ROLE GROWS



Phase 1: Take over and stabilise the finance administration above, learning our systems and conventions.

Phase 2: Expand the finance remit: cash flow forecasting, billing-schedule design, tighter credit control, and proactive prevention of bookkeeping queries before they arise.



Beyond that, the role is deliberately open-ended. We are building a long-term relationship, not filling a fixed list of tasks, and we expect the role to grow and reshape itself around the strengths and ambitions of the person we hire.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Weekly bookkeeping queries from our accountants drop close to zero, because issues are caught before they are raised.

The books are reconciled and up to date at all times.

The directors receive reliable, clear reporting every week and never have to chase for the numbers.

Suppliers are paid accurately on a controlled weekly cycle, and clients are invoiced and chased without director involvement.



ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



Demonstrable experience in UK construction finance and bookkeeping.

Hands-on CIS experience: subcontractor verification, deductions and monthly returns.

Working knowledge of the VAT domestic reverse charge for construction.

Strong Xero experience across reconciliation, invoicing and reporting (Xero certification / Xero Advisor an advantage).

Experience with Dext or similar invoice and receipt capture software.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

AI literacy. It is essential that you know how to use and leverage AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT and similar) to work faster and more efficiently - while understanding that AI is an assistant, not a replacement for judgement. You must apply a human eye to everything AI produces and take responsibility for checking that the work is correct, rather than letting the tools run unchecked.

Able to work remotely with significant overlap with UK business hours for meetings and updates.



DESIRABLE



AAT qualified or part-qualified, or qualified by experience.

Experience with Xero bill-payment and approval-workflow tools (for example ApprovalMax, Telleroo, Comma or Crezco).

Cash flow forecasting and management-reporting experience.

Job-costing, CVR or WIP experience in a contracting environment.

Confident with spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) for reporting.



PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES



Proactive and self-managing - anticipates problems rather than waiting to be asked.

Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive financial information.

Organised, reliable and a clear communicator with the directors.



PRACTICAL DETAILS



Remote, part-time, 25 hours per week, with overlap with UK business hours.

Reports to the Co-Director (Isaac).

Core tools: Dext, Xero, a payment-approval platform, Google Workspace and WhatsApp.

Standard (non-admin) Xero access and preparer-only rights in the payment system; the directors retain sole payment authority.

A confidentiality agreement / NDA will be required.

Rate: to be confirmed.

We expect process documentation via Loom — walking through the workflow used, including the specific AI prompts involved — so that any process can be understood, refined, and replicated by the team.



Availability & working style: We're innovative, but we're also traditional in one important way: this is a true 9-to-5 role on US Central Time, and that's non-negotiable. Just as important — we need someone who works the same hours every single day. Consistency is essential; we expect team members to be online, available, and responsive to Slack messages and huddles on a predictable daily schedule. This is a full-time, exclusive engagement. Depending on fit, we may start at part-time hours with a clear path to full-time — but the expectation of consistent, predictable daily availability applies from day one.



Budget: $2,000–$2,600/month depending on experience and skill level.

title: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film
description:
AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film



We are looking for an experienced AI video creator / video editor to produce a professional product film for a specialized industrial / defense-related product: a sea container protected with a ballistic coating.



This is a one-time paid project, but it may lead to more product videos, industrial presentations, AI films and marketing materials in the future.



## Project Overview



The product is a sea container with a protective ballistic coating designed to reduce fragmentation risk and improve safety in high-risk environments.



The container can be used in:



* conflict-risk zones,

* military or security environments,

* field bases,

* logistics zones,

* temporary operational areas,

* checkpoints,

* emergency infrastructure,

* equipment storage areas,

* industrial and uniformed services applications.



The film will be used mainly for business communication with Ukrainian companies, institutions, contractors and potential distributors. It may be sent together with a PDF product presentation or placed on a simple landing page with product information.



The goal is to present the product as a practical, serious and professional protective solution for demanding environments.



## Important Style Direction



We do **not** want a Hollywood action trailer.



We do **not** want exaggerated war scenes, explosions, violence, gore or political propaganda.



We need a realistic, industrial, serious B2B product film.



The style should feel:



* realistic,

* industrial,

* cinematic but controlled,

* professional,

* technical,

* practical,

* suitable for B2B / institutional buyers,

* suitable for the Ukrainian market,

* serious and trustworthy.



Think more: industrial defense product presentation / field logistics solution / protective infrastructure film.



Think less: action movie / war propaganda / dramatic combat trailer.



## Materials We Will Provide



We will provide:



* product photos,

* product description,

* technical information,

* website link,

* visual references,

* key selling points,

* company / contact details for final screen.



The film should be generated and edited using AI tools and video editing tools based on these materials.



You may use AI video, AI image generation, editing, motion graphics, overlays, cinematic transitions, sound design, product visualization and realistic environment creation.



## What the Film Should Show



The film should present:



* the container as a real industrial / protective product,

* the ballistic coating as a protective surface layer,

* possible use in high-risk environments,

* use in field / military / logistics / temporary infrastructure settings,

* mobility and practical deployment,

* potential functions such as:



  * field office,

  * equipment storage,

  * temporary shelter,

  * logistics point,

  * technical room,

  * checkpoint,

  * operational support unit,

* the concept of reducing fragmentation risk,

* professional use by companies, services, contractors or uniformed units.



## Suggested Film Structure



The final creative structure can be proposed by you, but one possible scenario is:



### 1. Opening Environment



A realistic field logistics environment: temporary base, industrial yard, training ground or operational zone. Dust, vehicles in the distance, serious atmosphere, calm cinematic movement.



Text idea:

“Protective modular infrastructure for high-risk environments.”



### 2. Product Reveal



The sea container appears as a strong, practical structure. Slow camera movement around the container. Close-ups of the coated surface.



Text idea:

“Sea container with ballistic protective coating.”



### 3. Risk Context



Subtle reference to difficult environments: damaged infrastructure, distant smoke, field logistics, temporary deployment, security area. No graphic violence, no direct combat scenes.



Text idea:

“Designed for environments where fragmentation risk and operational safety matter.”



### 4. Protection Layer Visualization



A clean visual showing the coating layer on the container surface. This can be done through AI, motion graphics or simple technical overlay.



Text idea:

“Protective coating designed to reduce fragmentation risk.”



### 5. Use Cases



Fast but clear sequence showing possible applications:



* field office,

* storage unit,

* temporary shelter,

* logistics point,

* equipment room,

* checkpoint,

* emergency infrastructure.



Text idea:

“Mobile. Practical. Adaptable.”



### 6. Deployment



Container transported, placed on site, used as part of a temporary base or operational zone.



### 7. Closing Frame



Strong final frame with the container in a serious field / industrial environment.



Text idea:

“Protective container solutions for demanding conditions.”



Final screen: company name / website / contact details.



## Expected Deliverables



Please quote for one or more of the following packages:



### Basic Package



* Main film: 45–75 seconds

* 1 thumbnail / cover

* 1–2 revision rounds



### Extended Package



* Main film: 45–75 seconds

* 30-second version

* 15-second teaser

* 1 thumbnail / cover

* 3–5 still visuals for PDF or landing page

* 1–2 revision rounds



### Optional Add-ons



* Ukrainian language text version

* English language text version

* Polish language text version

* social media format versions

* landing page hero video loop

* extra thumbnails / stills



## Tools / Skills Needed



Please tell us which tools you use, for example:



* Runway,

* Kling,

* Luma,

* Veo / Flow,

* Midjourney,

* ChatGPT,

* CapCut,

* Adobe Premiere Pro,

* DaVinci Resolve,

* After Effects,

* Photoshop,

* Canva,

* other AI image / video tools.



We are especially interested in creators who can combine AI-generated scenes with realistic product presentation, industrial environments and clean editing.



## Application Requirements



Please apply with the subject:



**BALLISTIC CONTAINER AI FILM**



In your application, please include:



1. Your portfolio or links to similar AI video / product video / industrial video work.

2. Which AI video tools you use.

3. Which editing tools you use.

4. Your proposed approach for this project.

5. Estimated price for the Basic Package.

6. Estimated price for the Extended Package.

7. Estimated delivery time.

8. Number of revision rounds included.

9. Whether you can create realistic industrial / defense-style visuals without making the film look like an action movie.

10. Whether you can prepare English and/or Ukrainian text versions.



Applications without video examples or portfolio links will not be considered.



## Important Notes



This film is for a serious B2B product presentation.



It must look professional, realistic and practical.



It should not include graphic violence, political messaging, unrealistic combat scenes or exaggerated explosions.



We are looking for someone who understands how to create a premium industrial product video using AI while keeping the tone serious, credible and business-oriented.

The cold callers should know how to professionally navigate gatekeepers, identify decision-makers, collect accurate details, and make meaningful business-to-business calls.



This is not a hard-selling role. Your main responsibility is to call sign shops and printing shops in North America, identify the right contact person, collect accurate information, and confirm whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit. Our internal sales team will handle qualified leads and follow-up conversations.

Call sign shops, print shops, and commercial signage companies in North America.

Confirm whether the company is a good fit for NOVA’s wholesale/custom signage manufacturing services.

Handle gatekeepers professionally and politely.

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, and professional accent.

title: Spanish Content QA Assistant – YouTube Script Production (Claude AI)
description:
IMPORTANT: This job requires advanced or native-level Castilian Spanish. This is non-negotiable. If you do not have a strong command of written Spanish from Spain, please do not apply.



---



WHAT THIS JOB IS



I run a Spanish-language YouTube channel focused on Stoic philosophy for sleep and mental wellness. I need a virtual assistant to help manage the production of long-form scripts using a fully systematized process powered by Claude AI.



This is NOT a writing or creative job. You will not be writing scripts. You will be operating a system. Everything you need is provided: 



A detailed onboarding document

Word files to attach to Claude

Exact prompts to copy and paste at each step

A quality checklist to follow when reviewing the output. 



Your job is to execute the process precisely and pay very close attention to the corrections that need to be requested from Claude, following the quality requirements exactly.



The key skill this job requires is not creativity or knowledge of the topic. It is the ability to follow a detailed system step by step, read carefully, and apply correction criteria with precision and consistency.



---



WHAT THE PROCESS LOOKS LIKE



Step 1 — You set up a Claude project using the documents and instructions we provide. This takes around 5 minutes and is fully explained in the onboarding document.



Step 2 — Using the exact prompts we give you, you generate the script lesson by lesson inside the Claude project. Claude does all the writing. Each script contains approximately 30,000 words generated automatically by Claude. Your role is not to write the content yourself. Instead, you will supervise the generation process, review each lesson using the provided quality checklist, and request corrections when needed. The writing itself is handled by Claude; your responsibility is quality control and ensuring that the output meets the standards defined in the system.



Step 3 — You review each lesson against a detailed quality checklist we provide. When something does not meet the criteria, you request specific corrections from Claude following the exact instructions we give you for each type of issue. The checklist tells you exactly what to look for and how to ask for changes.



Step 4 — You deliver the completed and reviewed script as a Word document.



Every single step is documented. You will never need to improvise or make creative decisions. What is required is careful attention, precision, and a genuine commitment to following the process correctly.



---



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A complete onboarding document explaining every step of the process

- All Word documents to attach to the Claude project

- The exact prompts to use at each moment of the process

- A detailed quality checklist with specific criteria and instructions for every type of correction

- Full support during the first script to answer any questions (we strongly encourage asking questions at any point, especially during the first script — the sooner any doubt is raised, the faster the process becomes fully manageable and the easier it is to correct course before too much work has been done)



---



REQUIREMENTS



- Advanced or native Castilian Spanish. This is the most critical requirement. The channel uses only standard Spanish from Spain and you need to read and evaluate the text accurately.

- Access to Claude.ai Pro plan ($20/month). This is the tool used for all script generation. It is required to do this job.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written instructions with precision.

- Reliable availability and consistent communication.



---



VOLUME AND SCOPE



We produce approximately 1 script every 2 days. Each script contains between 20 and 25 lessons and totals around 30,000 words — generated by Claude following the system, not written manually by you.



We will start with a paid trial of 1 complete script. If the process goes well and the quality meets the standards, the first project will consist of 10 scripts. The goal is to build a long-term working relationship with the right person.



---



TO APPLY





Please write your application in Spanish and tell us:



Your Spanish level and how you acquired it.



Your experience with AI tools — especially giving precise correction instructions to get specific results.



Can you spot typical AI writing patterns in Spanish text — repetitive structures, formulaic phrases, transitions that feel unnatural or interchangeable between paragraphs? If so, could you give us 3 or 4 concrete examples of the kind of constructions you would flag? This is one of the most important skills for this role.



Any experience following detailed checklists or quality control processes.



Applications in English only will not be considered.

title: Full-Stack IVR & AI Developer (Telnyx, ChatGPT, Docker)

Speech-to-Text & Text-to-Speech Integration



Integrate OpenAI/ChatGPT or Amazon Polly/Whisper for conversational IVR, dynamic responses, and language support.

Pre-generate and cache audio files for store greetings/marketing messages.

Google My Business Data Handling



Develop a background service or cron job to fetch and update store details (hours, address, etc.) for use in dynamic IVR prompts.

Cache data to minimize external API calls.

Voi
 & Queue Management

Set up voi
 recording, transcription (via STT), and auto
ing to store owners.

Outbound SMS



Utilize Telnyx Messaging API to send directions or marketing texts to callers who opt in.

Capture and store phone numbers in a database for future marketing campaigns (with compliance considerations).

High Availability & Failover



Configure Docker-based deployment on Ubuntu (Hetzner).

Set up a secondary failover server or floating IP for continuous operation if the primary server goes down.

Admin Panel / GUI



Create a web-based admin dashboard (React, Vue, or Angular + Node.js/Express backend) to manage store settings, greetings, marketing messages, voi
s, etc.

Implement user roles (multi-tenant access) so different store owners can log in and manage their own data.

Testing & Maintenance



Write unit/integration tests for stability.

Monitor call volumes, handle concurrency, optimize performance, and troubleshoot production issues.

Qualifications

Technical Skills



Strong experience with Node.js (Express or similar) OR Python (FastAPI) for backend development.

Proficiency in Docker (Docker Compose or Kubernetes a plus) for containerized deployments.

Experience with VoIP/Telephony APIs (Telnyx, Twilio, or similar).

Knowledge of Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech technologies (OpenAI, Amazon Polly, Google Cloud STT).

Frontend development skills (React, Vue, or Angular) for building the Admin GUI.

Familiarity with databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) for multi-tenant data management.

System Architecture & DevOps



Comfortable setting up Ubuntu servers on Hetzner and configuring SSL (Cloudflare or Let’s Encrypt).

Experience with CI/CD, load balancing, failover, and high-availability architectures.

Soft Skills



Ability to work independently and take full ownership of the project from concept to deployment.

Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Problem-solving attitude—you enjoy tackling new challenges and optimizing solutions.

Preferred Experience



Hands-on with CRM integration, multi-language IVR solutions, or large-scale telephony projects.

Experience with PCI compliance and secure handling of sensitive data.

Tools & Technologies You’ll Work With

Node.js / Express (or Python / FastAPI)

Docker & Docker Compose

Telnyx Voice & Messaging APIs

OpenAI / ChatGPT, Amazon Polly, or other STT/TTS solutions

PostgreSQL or MySQL for data storage

Nginx, Let’s Encrypt/Cloudflare for SSL & reverse proxy

Google My Business / Google Maps APIs

Git for version control

title: Live On-Camera Puppeteer and Host (Part-Time, US Hours)
description:
LIVE ON-CAMERA PUPPETEER AND HOST (PART-TIME, US HOURS)



We run a live, fast-paced online show about real-money odds. Think a sports highlights show, but for live betting markets: loud, funny, and a little unhinged. We are looking for a live on-camera performer to be the face of it, operating a hand puppet and reading our script live with big energy and comic timing



This is a live performance role, not a recording job. You go on camera at scheduled times, follow cues from our director, read from an on-screen teleprompter, and ad-lib reactions as the markets move. Your real voice and personality are the star.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Perform live on camera operating a hand or sock puppet, reading our script with energy and humour.

- Follow live cues and timing from the director and react in real time to fast-changing markets.

- Hold a consistent character voice and high energy across the whole show.

- Be fully set up and connection-tested before every live session.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Excellent spoken English, clear and lively, with strong comic timing and the confidence to be animated and silly on camera.

- Reliability and punctuality, and the ability to commit to a fixed live schedule on US hours.

- A 1080p webcam, a clear microphone or headset, and a quiet space.

- Fast, stable internet with a backup connection, and backup power. This is essential for live work.

- Comfort using Chrome and a browser link (VDO.Ninja) and reading from a teleprompter.

- The ability to hang a simple green sheet behind you for background removal.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in on-camera hosting, voice acting, streaming, theatre, improv, comedy, or puppetry.

- An interest in sports, crypto, or betting a plus 



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Part-time, about 10 to 12 hours a week. Our show runs on US hours.

- $6 to $7 per hour to start, reviewed after a two-week paid trial.



TO APPLY

- Start your message with the word SOCKS so we know you read this.

- Send a 60 to 90 second audition video. Read this line in a fun, over-the-top voice, with a puppet on your hand if you can: "Folks, the weather market just went bananas, Miami at fourteen cents and dropping, and the desk is sweating!"

- Tell us your internet speed, whether you have backup power, your webcam model, and your weekly availability in US Eastern time.
