title: Remote Executive Admin & Finance (QuickBooks + AI Systems Support)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Are you a detail-oriented, systems-minded Virtual Professional who enjoys keeping financial records organized, building clean trackers, and turning messy information into clear workflows?



We are looking for a proactive Executive Admin & Finance Virtual Professional who can support finance, admin, operations, reporting, and process documentation. This role is ideal for someone who is accurate with numbers, comfortable with QuickBooks or similar accounting tools, and excited about using AI responsibly to make work clearer, faster, and better documented.



This is not just a task-support role. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems - someone who enjoys creating SOPs, checklists, trackers, dashboards, templates, and better ways of managing recurring work.



You may be a great fit if you like organizing details, catching inconsistencies, improving processes, and helping leadership stay financially informed and operationally prepared.



What You Will Do

You will support day-to-day finance, admin, reporting, documentation, and workflow improvement tasks.



Finance & Bookkeeping Support

• Track invoices, receipts, payments, payables, receivables, reimbursements, and vendor records.

• Support QuickBooks Online or similar accounting systems with organized data entry, categorization, and cleanup.

• Assist with bank and credit card reconciliation support.

• Help maintain clean records for transactions, vendors, invoices, and supporting documents.

• Prepare financial trackers, summaries, simple reports, and management updates.

• Organize PDFs, screenshots, receipts, invoices, and related files so records are easy to find and review.

• Spot missing information, duplicate entries, inconsistent categories, and reporting gaps before they become bigger issues.



Executive Admin & Operations Support

• Manage calendars, reminders, meetings, follow-ups, deadlines, and recurring priorities.

• Coordinate administrative details, project trackers, vendor information, forms, and documentation.

• Support research, file organization, task follow-through, and internal updates.

• Give clear progress updates, ask smart questions, and close communication loops.

• Handle sensitive business and administrative information with discretion and professionalism.



Systems, SOPs & AI-Assisted Workflow Support

• Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, trackers, dashboards, templates, and process documentation.

• Turn scattered notes, screenshots, recordings, inbox items, or financial details into clear action steps.

• Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms to support summaries, research, documentation, first drafts, and workflow organization.

• Build simple prompt templates or AI-assisted workflows that make recurring tasks cleaner and faster.

• Review and verify AI output before sharing it.

• Protect confidential information and avoid relying on unchecked AI-generated answers.

• Recommend practical improvements when work is messy, manual, duplicated, or unclear.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is organized, accurate, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote setup. You should enjoy finance/admin work, but also be curious about systems, documentation, and smarter ways to get things done.



You may be a great fit if you:

• Have at least 2 years of experience in finance/admin, bookkeeping support, executive admin, operations, or a related role.

• Have hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or a similar accounting platform such as Xero, FreshBooks, Zoho Books, NetSuite, or similar tools.

• Are comfortable handling invoice tracking, AP/AR support, vendor records, reconciliation support, reporting, or financial admin tasks.

• Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for trackers, formulas, organized data, and reporting.

• Are highly detail-oriented and careful with numbers, deadlines, and confidential information.

• Can write clear updates in English and communicate proactively.

• Naturally organize recurring work into checklists, templates, SOPs, trackers, or dashboards.

• Are comfortable using AI tools as a work partner for drafting, summarizing, organizing, researching, and improving documentation.

• Understand that AI output must still be checked, verified, and handled responsibly.

• Are resourceful, coachable, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision.



Preferred Experience: Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• QuickBooks Online cleanup, categorization, reconciliation support, or financial reporting.

• Accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice tracking, or vendor management.

• KPI dashboards, management reports, data cleanup, or reporting packs.

• SOP creation, Loom/process videos, workflow documentation, trackers, or process maps.

• Project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, 
, Trello, Notion, or Airtable.

• CRM tools, automation tools, Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

• Supporting executives, operators, finance teams, or operations-heavy businesses.

• Coordinating applications, vendor setup, compliance research, permits, or project trackers.

• Using AI tools to improve admin, finance, reporting, documentation, or research workflows.



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements

To ensure a smooth and reliable remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher preferred.

• Minimum 8GB RAM.

• Laptop or PC preferably less than 3 years old.

• Stable internet connection of at least 50-100 Mbps preferred.

• Backup internet connection.

• Quality webcam, microphone, and headset.

Screenshots of device specs and internet speed test may be requested during the application process.



You Will Thrive in This Role If...

• You enjoy bringing order to messy information.

• You like working with numbers, reports, trackers, records, and follow-ups.

• You often think, "There has to be a better system for this."

• You can follow instructions carefully but also think ahead.

• You ask thoughtful questions when information is missing.

• You give clear updates without needing to be chased.

• You enjoy creating checklists, documentation, templates, and better workflows.

• You use AI thoughtfully to improve work quality, not to replace judgment.

• You want a long-term remote role where reliability, ownership, communication, and continuous improvement matter.



This May Not Be the Best Fit If...

• You prefer task-by-task instructions and do not enjoy organizing ambiguity.

• You are uncomfortable with financial records, details, deadlines, or accuracy checks.

• You do not like documenting processes or creating trackers.

• You are not open to learning new systems or AI tools.

• You use AI as a shortcut without checking the output.

• You struggle with proactive communication or independent remote work.



Why You Will Love This Opportunity

• Full-time remote work.

• Weekends off.

• Paid holidays and PTO eligibility.

• HMO eligibility after the required tenure period.

• Family Medical Incentive eligibility.

• PAG-IBIG and referral incentives.

• Learning sessions and growth opportunities.

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community.

• Opportunity to strengthen finance, admin, systems, documentation, and AI workflow skills.



How to Apply: Please submit:

• Your updated resume.

• Your answers to the application questions below.



Application Questions

1. Tell us about your finance, bookkeeping support, executive admin, or operations experience. Which tools have you used?

2. Walk us through how you would reconcile a bank or credit card account in QuickBooks Online, or how you would clean up a messy invoice/payment tracker.

3. Which AI tools have you used at work? Share one specific example of how you used AI to organize information, save time, improve documentation, or create a better workflow. How did you check the output for accuracy?

Applications with clear, specific answers will be prioritized. We are especially interested in candidates who can show real examples of finance/admin accuracy, systems thinking, responsible AI use, and proactive communication.



Apply today and build a meaningful remote career where your accuracy, initiative, and systems mindset can truly shine.

title: NDIS Operations Assistant
description:
About SyncAssist 

 

SyncAssist is a backend operations partner for NDIS providers across Australia. We do not provide direct support to people with disability. We fix the broken backend that stops providers from delivering great support. 

Our clients are NDIS businesses - typically 5 to 100 staff -  whose operations have outgrown their systems. Invoicing errors, compliance gaps, missed remittances, disorganised participant records. The kind of problems that create financial risk and audit exposure for providers and their participants. 

We go inside their systems - ShiftCare, Visual Care, Xero, MYOB, PRODA, Google Drive, SharePoint -  and we fix what is broken. We build structured workflows, document SOPs, and execute operational rhythms so providers can focus on care. 

This is not a general admin role. Every person on our team works directly inside live NDIS provider systems. The work is precise, compliance-sensitive, and directly connected to participant outcomes. If you get it wrong, a real person's funding is affected. 

We are a structured, systems-driven team. We use ClickUp for task management, Process Street for workflow execution, Airtable as our delivery engine, and Google Drive as our single source of document truth. We document everything. We follow SOPs. We escalate fast and we do not cut corners. 



If that sounds like the environment you thrive in, read on.



The Role:

Position: NDIS Operations Assistant     Reports to: Head of Client Operations and Delivery 



You will be embedded inside the backend operations of active NDIS providers. You are not a personal assistant. You are not a generalist VA. You are executing structured, compliance-sensitive workflows inside live provider systems - invoicing, participant records, service agreements, compliance registers - on behalf of clients who have paid for precision. 

You will work directly under the Head of Client Operations and Delivery, following documented SOPs for every task. You will not make decisions outside your scope. You will escalate issues immediately. You will deliver consistent, accurate output every week. 



What You Will Actually Be Doing :

These are the tasks you will own week to week. If you do not have direct experience with these tasks inside an NDIS provider context, do not apply. 



Invoicing and Finance Administration 

- Prepare weekly NDIS invoicing data from shift records in ShiftCare or similar scheduling platforms 

- Cross-reference service delivery records against participant plan budgets before submitting claims 

- Process and reconcile remittance advice from the NDIA against submitted claims 

- Track outstanding invoices in the financial workflow register 

- Execute the structured overdue invoice follow-up sequence as per SOP 

- Flag anomalies, budget shortfalls, or claim discrepancies to the Head of Operations immediately 

 

Participant and Provider Record Management 

- Maintain accurate participant records — personal details, plan dates, funding categories, support budgets 

- Prepare and manage service agreements, consent forms, and plan review documents 

- Update participant and staff registers in line with NDIS requirements and client-specific SOPs 

- Monitor participant funding utilisation and flag participants approaching budget limits 

- Manage document version control in Google Drive using SyncAssist file naming conventions 

 

Compliance and Register Maintenance 

- Maintain and update all client compliance registers — i
, complaints, staff credentials, and policy registers 

- Prepare document packs for scheduled audits and quality reviews 

- Identify gaps or overdue items in compliance registers and escalate within the agreed timeframe 

- Ensure all documents are filed in the correct folders following the client folder template 

 

 Triage and Inbox Management 

- Manage provider
 inboxes within the agreed daily rhythm 

- Sort, prioritise, and action or escalate
s within the agreed daily rhythm 

- Draft routine responses using approved templates for standard provider communications 

- Flag urgent or compliance-sensitive
s immediately 

 

Task and Workflow Management 

- Log all tasks, updates, and completion notes within the client task structure in ClickUp 

- Execute workflow steps exactly as documented — no shortcuts 

- Raise flags when a workflow step cannot be completed as documented 

- Update the weekly client delivery summary with status of all active workflows 

 

Non-Negotiable Requirements :

Every item below is a hard requirement. If you cannot demonstrate direct experience with each of these in an NDIS provider context, your application will not proceed. 



Requirements:

What we need to see

- NDIS invoicing  : Hands-on experience preparing NDIS claims - including PACE or PRODA submission workflows, claim codes, and support category budgets. Not just understanding invoicing in theory. 

- ShiftCare or equivalent : Direct experience in a rostering or NDIS scheduling platform — entering shifts, extracting invoice data, managing participant records. ShiftCare strongly preferred. 

- PRODA and PACE : Working knowledge of Services Australia systems. You should know what PRODA is used for, what can go wrong, and how to flag access issues. 

- Service agreements : Experience preparing or managing NDIS service agreements across plan management, self-managed, and agency-managed participant types. 

- Compliance registers : Experience maintaining participant, staff, and compliance registers in an NDIS context. Not just data entry - you must understand why these registers exist. 

- Google Workspace : Proficiency in Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets. Experience working within a structured folder system and following naming conventions. 

- ClickUp : Experience using ClickUp or a comparable task management platform for workflow tracking. You will be inside ClickUp every day. 

- SOP execution : You have worked in a role where you followed documented SOPs. You understand that SOPs are not suggestions. 

- Written English : Strong written English. You will be drafting communications, updating registers, and writing completion notes that the client may read. 



Tools You Will Use Daily :

- ClickUp : All task management, workflow tracking, and client delivery registers 

- Process Street : Step-by-step workflow execution for client delivery - every major task has a checklist 

- Google Drive : Document storage, SOP library, client folder management 

- Google Sheets : Financial tracking, compliance registers, utilisation monitoring 

- Airtable : Internal delivery engine - client data, task registers, workflow status 

- ShiftCare or equivalent : Client NDIS scheduling and invoice data extraction 

- Xero / MYOB : Client financial systems - invoice review, reconciliation support 

- PRODA / PACE : NDIS claim submission and participant record management (client systems only) 



The Kind of Person We Are Looking For 

- Beyond skills and experience, we are looking for a specific type of operator. 

- Process-driven. You find comfort in structure. You do not invent new ways to do things that already have a documented process. You follow the SOP, and when the SOP does not cover something, you escalate rather than guess. 

- Compliance-aware. You understand that in the NDIS space, errors in invoicing or participant records affect real people. You do not rush tasks. You check your work before you mark it complete. 

- Proactive and visible. You do not go quiet. You check in at 9am and 4pm, every day, without being chased. If something is delayed or blocked, you say so before it becomes a problem. 

- Accurate over fast. You would rather take an extra ten minutes and get it right than submit something that creates a downstream error. Rework is expensive for everyone. 

- Long-term focused. We are not interested in contractors who will leave in 90 days. We invest in training and onboarding and we expect commitment in return. 

 

Important - Please Read Before Applying :

- Confidentiality and Data Handling : SyncAssist works inside credentialed client systems. This means we handle PRODA access, NDIS participant data, Xero accounts, and provider compliance files on behalf of our clients. 

All client data is strictly confidential. You will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement before commencing. You will not retain, store, or use any client data outside the scope of your assigned tasks. 

 

Applications without direct NDIS experience will not proceed. 

This is not a role where you will be trained in NDIS administration from scratch. You need to arrive already knowing the system. Applications from general virtual assistants or those without direct NDIS provider experience will not be considered. 



 How to Apply :

Submit your application using the link below. Select Administrative Assistant in the role field. 



In your application, be specific. Tell us: 

- Which NDIS providers or provider types you have worked with 

- What systems you used 

- One specific example of a compliance or invoicing error you caught and fixed

title: Insta Ideas Rockstar
description:
About the Role:



We're a health and wellness marketing company with several product lines — including men's health/energy & stamina supplements, lymphatic drainage/detox products and gut health tonics. We're looking for someone with a sharp eye for viral short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) who can spot what's working, why it's working, and turn that insight into ideas our team can build creatives around.



This starts as a research and script-writing role, but for the right person it grows into a full Creative Strategist position with real ownership over content direction across our product lines.





What You'll Do:



Spend time daily inside mainly Instagram Reels (less on TikTok and Shorts) hunting for videos that are genuinely going viral — in health/wellness, and in adjacent niches where the same pain points or hook structures show up (fitness, masculinity, biohacking, etc.)

Break down why a video works: the hook, the pain point or desire it's tapping into, the pacing, the format

Flag which elements of a viral video could realistically be recreated using AI tools (AI avatars, voice cloning, AI b-roll, etc.) as we mainly use AI influencers.

Turn the strongest finds into rough drafts with a logical flow (hook + angle + structure) adapted to our specific products

Hand those drafts to our creative team, who will develop them into full ad and organic scripts

Stay on top of platform trends and shifts in what's currently performing





Daily responsibilities:



Find inspiration for 4 current brands, around 8 videos/brand/day.

Transcribing the videos and making sure the words are accurate.

For shorter videos, rewriting the script with AI for different personalities.





What We're Looking For



A track record of spotting viral content before it's obvious — you can show us examples of videos you called early or content you helped create that performed well

Strong script or copywriting ability, ideally for short-form video or direct-response ads

A real, practical understanding of AI content tools (AI avatars, voice clones, AI-generated footage) — not just that they exist, but where they fall short and where they shine

Comfort working in the health/wellness/supplement space

Self-directed — you don't need someone telling you which hashtag to check today

Fluent English for writing scripts that land naturally with a US audience





Nice to Have



Experience with DTC/e-commerce brands or performance marketing

Awareness of ad compliance basics for health and supplement claims (we can't make medical claims, and knowing that going in is a big plus)

Past experience trending into a creative strategist, content lead, or UGC manager role
salary: $500+ to start with room for growth

title: Virtual Assistant — Lead Generation & Content Operations (Part-Time, 15 hrs/week)
description:
ABOUT FUTUREGIG:

Hiring at most companies is a mess. FutureGig exists to fix that.

We're a lean recruiting consulting company helping small and mid-size businesses build hiring processes that actually work — without replacing the humans that make those processes good.

This isn't a big agency. It's not a corporate machine. It's a scrappy, fast-moving team that believes AI should make recruiters better, not replace them. Human First. AI Powered. That's not a tagline — it's how we operate every day.

You'd be joining early. That means your fingerprints are on everything.



THE ROLE:

We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Virtual Assistant to run our lead generation and content operations system. This is a part-time role — 15 hours per week — with the expectation of expanding to full-time as the business grows.

You will work inside Notion, LinkedIn, and Buffer. You will follow documented SOPs for every task. You will not need to improvise or make judgment calls — your job is to execute the system precisely and flag anything that needs the founder's attention.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, takes pride in accurate work, communicates proactively, and wants to grow with a company long term.



YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Monday — Prospect Research (3 hours)



Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify 20 new qualified prospects per week

Filter by: HR Director, Head of People, VP of HR, TA Manager titles; 50–500 employee companies; non-advertising industries

Add all prospects to the Notion Prospect Tracker database with complete information

Flag the batch as ready for founder review before outreach begins



Tuesday & Wednesday — Outreach Execution (5 hours)



Execute the 5-touch LinkedIn outreach sequence on all active prospects

Follow the exact outreach templates provided — personalize one specific detail per message

Update prospect status, touch number, last action date, and next action date in Notion after every touch

Never send more than 20 connection requests per day

Flag any responses immediately for the founder — do not reply on behalf of FutureGig



Thursday — Content Drafting & Scheduling (4 hours)



Draft two LinkedIn posts per week for the FutureGig company page using the content brief framework provided

Write a strong hook (first line), full post body, and select 5 hashtags from the approved set

Submit drafts in Notion with status set to "Needs Review"

Once approved by founder, schedule posts in Buffer at assigned times

Maintain at least 2 weeks of approved content in the queue at all times



Friday — Weekly Report (2 hours)



Complete the weekly report template in Notion covering: prospects added, outreach touches executed, responses received, content status, and any blockers

Flag any prospect responses or situations needing the founder's attention

Send founder a brief message that the report is ready for review

Plan the following week's task list



TOOLS YOU WILL USE:



Notion (task tracking, SOPs, content calendar, prospect database)

LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator (prospect research and outreach)

Buffer (content scheduling)

 or WhatsApp (weekly check-ins with founder)



Full training and SOPs will be provided for every tool and task. You do not need prior experience with all of these tools — but you must be a fast learner and comfortable with new software.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Required:

- Excellent written English — you will be drafting LinkedIn content and personalized outreach messages

- Strong attention to detail — accurate data entry in Notion is critical

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during agreed hours

- Proactive communicator — you flag issues before they become problems

- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

- Experience with LinkedIn preferred but not required



Preferred:



- Prior experience as a VA for a consulting, recruiting, or B2B company

- Familiarity with CRM or database tools (Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, etc.)

- Experience drafting professional content or copywriting

- Understanding of LinkedIn outreach and lead generation



WHAT THIS IS NOT:



- This is not a sales role — you will never pitch or close clients

- This is not a creative director role — content topics and frameworks are provided

- This is not a customer service role — all client communication goes through the founder



COMPENSATION & HOURS:



$350/month USD

15 hours per week

Part-time with strong potential to expand to full-time as the business grows

Flexible schedule within the Monday–Friday week — tasks are structured by day, not by hour



HOW TO APPLY:

title: Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a high-velocity Video Editor to join the Revvin team on a part-time basis, with an immediate opportunity to scale up to a full-time role based on performance. You will be responsible for transforming raw footage into high-impact video assets for the automotive and real estate industries. This role requires a "strategic editing" mindset, creating content that ranges from cinematic automotive films and luxury property tours to high-engagement, fast-paced social media ads.

The ideal candidate understands how to capture attention in the first 2 seconds, has a proven track record editing luxury real estate/automotive content, utilizes advanced editing effects, and leverages AI video tools to maintain our high-production standards at scale.



Key Responsibilities:

- Strategic Video Editing: Assemble raw footage into polished, high-conversion video for both short-form and long-form platforms. Every cut should be intentional and designed to drive engagement.



- Advanced Visual Effects & Motion Graphics: Level up our content using dynamic transition effects, motion tracking, seamless speed ramping, cinematic zooms, custom text overlays, and stylized animations.



- Sound Design & Colour Grading: Elevate raw footage through professional colour grading (bringing out luxury car paint finishes and bright, crisp property interiors) and impactful sound design/mixing.



- AI Video Integration: Utilize AI tools for automated captioning, voiceovers, frame expansion, and "smart" b-roll selection to accelerate the workflow without sacrificing quality.



- Brand-First Creativity: Work within brand guidelines while injecting your own creative flair to make every project stand out.



- Fast Turnaround: Manage multiple videos and projects simultaneously. At Revvin, our standard is a 24-48 hour turnaround time for most creative requests.



Qualifications & Skills:

- Mandatory Industry Experience: Proven, hands-on experience editing for the Real Estate or Automotive sectors. You must know how to edit a property tour to look aspirational, luxurious, and smooth.



- Effects & Software Mastery: Expert-level skills in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. You must be comfortable implementing clean, modern visual effects and seamless motion design.



- Design Fundamentals: Knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator to manipulate assets and create custom motion elements.



- AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience with AI-driven video tools to enhance production speed and visual quality.



- Visual Storytelling: A portfolio that demonstrates an understanding of pacing, rhythm, and a "director’s eye" for what to highlight.



What We Look For:

-Precision & Neatness: We value "clean" editors who are intentional with their work. We want individuals who take pride in their craft, not those who simply "slap things together."



-Strategic Thinking: You don't just edit; you understand the "why" behind a scene. You know how to highlight the best features of a vehicle or a home to make it look premium.



-Speed: A professional who thrives on hitting our 24-48 hour production window.



-Feedback Loop: The ability to take creative direction and execute revisions with a fast turnaround.





HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY) 

We do not review applications submitted directly through this platform. To be considered for this role, you must officially apply by filling out our brief application questionnaire.



Google Form: 



Applications without a completed form and portfolio links will be automatically disqualified. We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Part-Time Zoho Ecosystem Specialist & Accountant (10 hrs/week)

Our accounting needs are incredibly straightforward and will only take a fraction of your time. The real magic of this role lies in your ability to build, connect, and optimize our Zoho One suite. Excellent written and spoken English.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Sourcer
description:
ONLINE ARBITRAGE PRODUCT SOURCER – FULL TIME



We are a growing Amazon Online Arbitrage business looking to hire one full-time Product Sourcer for a long-term role with room for growth and advancement. This position begins with a 5-day paid trial period before transitioning into a full-time role.



We are building a long-term operation and are looking for dependable tea
mbers who want to grow with us and eventually step into leadership or management roles.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a complete application as per requirements highlighted below. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



This is a full-time exclusive position. Applicants currently sourcing for other Amazon sellers or working with multiple OA clients will not be considered.



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer who can consistently identify profitable products while following company systems and SOPs.



The ideal candidate is dependable, proactive, analytical, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.



All leads are expected to be independently researched, meet our sourcing criteria, and align with company SOPs. We have internal systems in place to maintain sourcing quality and originality.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



• Source 10–15 profitable, in-stock leads per day

 • Maintain a lead approval rate of 75% or higher

 • Conduct high-quality product research using approved sourcing methods

 • Ensure sourced products meet profitability and purchasing standards

 • Follow, maintain, and help improve SOPs

 • Communicate clearly with tea
mbers

 • Maintain consistency in daily workflow and lead submissions



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS



Applicants must have:



• Previous Online Arbitrage sourcing experience

 • Keepa experience

 • SellerAmp/SAS experience

 • Reliable internet connection

 • Ability to work full-time, 40 hours per week

 • Strong communication skills

 • High attention to detail

 • Strong analytical ability



Applicants should have a strong understanding of:



• ROI

 • Profit margins

 • Sales rank

 • Keepa charts

 • Pricing history

 • Buy Box behavior

 • Product competition



Because many of our tea
mbers are located outside the United States, a VPN is required to access and source from U.S.-based retailers. Applicants should already have experience using a VPN while sourcing products.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, you must complete all requirements listed below.



1. Submit 3 Profitable OA Leads



Please submit 3 profitable OA leads sourced within the last 24 hours.



For each lead, include:

 • Supplier link

 • Amazon US link

 • Buy Cost

 • Sale Price

 • ROI

 • Estimated Monthly Sales



Each lead must meet the following criteria:

 • Minimum 30% ROI

 • Low sales rank

 • In stock and immediately purchasable

 • Keepa chart showing a low probability of dropping below break-even pricing



2. Submit a 3–5 Minute Sourcing Video



Please include a 3–5 minute screen-recorded sourcing video showing:



• How you found the lead

 • Your sourcing method

 • SellerAmp/SAS analysis

 • Keepa analysis

 • Why you believe the lead is profitable/ a good lead



3. Answer the Application Questions



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Have you previously worked as an Online Arbitrage Sourcer?

If so, why did you leave your previous role/client?

What is your preferred sourcing method and why?

What are the first three things you check when evaluating a lead?

Why would you be a strong fit for this opportunity?

Do you have active SellerAmp and Keepa subscriptions?

How many Amazon OA clients have you worked with in the past 12 months?

Are you currently working with any Amazon sellers or e-commerce clients? If yes, please explain.

What was the longest period you worked with a single Amazon seller or e-commerce client?

Why are you interested in this position?



Please also include:

 • Screenshot of your internet speed

 • 20-second voice recording explaining why you would be a good fit for this opportunity



ATTENTION TO DETAIL

To ensure attention to detail, please include the following in your application title:



Favorite Fruit | Years of OA Experience



Example: Apple | 2 Years OA



HIRING PROCESS



Stage 1: Application Review



We will review your application, submitted leads, sourcing video, and required materials.



Stage 2: Interview



Qualified applicants will be invited to an interview.



Stage 3: 5-Day Paid Trial Period



Selected candidates will complete a 5-day paid trial period.



During the paid trial, candidates will be evaluated on:

 • Lead quality

 • Approval rate

 • Communication

 • Consistency

 • Ability to follow SOPs

 • Overall fit within the team



Candidates who successfully complete the trial period may be offered a long-term full-time position.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



• Competitive pay

 • Performance bonuses

 • PTO

 • Paid holidays

 • Long-term growth opportunities within the company



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and eager to grow within a long-term role.



This is a competitive industry, and we value consistency, accountability, strong communication, and strong sourcing ability.



We are especially interested in candidates who take ownership of their work, ask questions when needed, and are committed to maintaining high sourcing standards.



RELIABILITY EXPECTATIONS



Reliability is extremely important in this role.



Consistent attendance, meeting deadlines, and maintaining communication are key performance expectations.



Frequent unexcused absences, missed workdays, or extended communication gaps will not be tolerated.



COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Communication is extremely important, especially during onboarding and training.



During your first few weeks, frequent communication will be expected to ensure you fully understand our sourcing criteria, SOPs, and workflow.



We would rather answer questions early than have mistakes made due to assumptions.



Candidates should be comfortable communicating through WhatsApp and/or 
 and providing regular updates throughout the workday when requested.



CONFIDENTIALITY



All sourcing methods, lead lists, SOPs, systems, business information, and company processes are confidential.



They may not be shared, copied, sold, distributed, or used outside of this position.



By accepting this role, you agree to maintain the confidentiality of all company information and sourcing methods.



Thank you for taking the time to apply. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Customer Service & Marketing Specialist for a US Electrical Company (AI-Forward, Long-Term, Overnight)
description:
Rizen Electric is a faith-driven, family-run residential electrical company in Arizona, USA. Our mission is simple: brighten people's day. We treat our customers like family and we treat our team the same way. We run a modern, AI-assisted operation, and we are looking for ONE sharp, warm, dependable person to be the heartbeat of our customer experience for the long haul. This is a career seat, not a gig.



What this role is

You are the friendly voice our customers hear and the person who makes sure none of them ever falls through the cracks. You start by owning our phones and bookings. As you master that, you grow into running our marketing and helping us build smart AI workflows. We will train you on everything specific to us. We provide the phone system, the tools, and clear step-by-step playbooks for every part of the job.



What you will own (starting day one)



Answer every incoming call warmly and professionally and book the appointment.

Respond to new leads fast (within minutes, not hours). Speed wins the job.

Capture complete info on every call: name, full address, cell number, and texting consent.

Run our follow-up loop: thank-you "happy calls" after each job, follow up on quotes that did not close yet, request reviews from happy customers, and thank customers who refer us.

Respond to every Google review, good and bad, the same day.

Keep our schedule and customer records clean and accurate in our CRM.

What you will grow into (first 2 to 3 months)



Post consistently on social media and stay active in local community groups.

Keep our Google Business Profile fresh with photos, posts, and answered questions.

Send simple
 promotions to past customers and create "customer of the month" posts.

Use our AI tools to draft, organize, and speed everything up, and help us build new workflows as you learn. If you love AI and automation, this is where you shine.

You must have (the non-negotiables)



Excellent spoken English with a clear, warm, easy-to-understand phone voice. This is the single most important requirement and we will assess it on a live call.

A genuinely positive, caring, can-do attitude. We hire for attitude and train the skills.

A proven track record on the US overnight shift, reliably, long-term.

Real comfort with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and a habit of using them. Bonus for having built or run automations.

Fast at learning new software. Reliable computer, fast internet, quiet space, good headset.



What we offer

Competitive pay starting at $5.32/hr, 32hrs-40hrs a week, with raises as you grow into more.

Long-term, full-time stability with a company that values you as a person.

Real growth: own the phones, then marketing, then AI workflows.

A modern, AI-forward operation and a team that genuinely cares.

Paid trial period before a permanent offer.

How to apply (read carefully!)



Record a 60 to 90 second voice clip introducing yourself and answering: "Tell me about a time you helped a frustrated or upset customer, and how you turned it around." Share it as a link.

Answer in two or three sentences: "What AI tool do you use most, and what is one task you use it for?" Applications without both will not be reviewed. We read the ones who follow these steps first.

title: Virtual email assistant with some accounting knowledge
description:
Virtual Assistant / Executive Communications Assistant



 Management | WeChat Communications | Payments | Basic Accounting Admin



We are seeking a reliable, proactive, and highly organised Virtual Assistant to assist with daily business communications,
 management, WeChat messages, supplier follow-ups, payment reminders, and general administration.



This role is suitable for someone who enjoys working closely with a business owner, can manage multiple tasks, and is confident working autonomously on a day-to-day basis.



The successful candidate will support several business operations across accounting, hospitality, retail, ecommerce, and other growing business projects.



About the Role



We are looking for a Virtual Assistant who can help keep daily communications organised and ensure important tasks,
s, messages, and payment deadlines are not missed.



You will assist with reviewing
s, monitoring WeChat and other chat applications, drafting professional responses, tracking invoices and payments due, and providing daily updates on urgent matters.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, trustworthy, detail-focused, and looking for a long-term role with responsibility and growth potential.



Key Responsibilities



 Management



You will be required to:



* Review incoming
s daily.

* Identify urgent
s and notify management immediately.

* Organise
s by priority, business, supplier, client, legal, finance, and general matters.

* Draft professional
 responses for review and approval.

* Follow up on outstanding
s.

* Keep clear notes of communication history and required actions.



WeChat and Chat Application Communications



You will assist with:



* Monitoring WeChat and other business chat applications.

* Summarising important messages.

* Drafting responses for approval.

* Responding to basic messages where authorised.

* Keeping track of commitments made through chat messages.

* Escalating urgent supplier, staff, client, or business matters.



Payment and Invoice Reminders



You will help with:



* Reviewing supplier invoices and payment requests.

* Tracking payment due dates.

* Preparing daily or weekly payment summaries.

* Following up suppliers for invoices, receipts, statements, and confirmations.

* Preparing simple payment lists showing supplier name, invoice number, due date, amount owing, and priority.

* Flagging overdue payments, urgent payment requests, and unusual payment issues.



Basic Accounting and Finance Administration



The successful candidate should have basic accounting knowledge and be comfortable handling finance administration tasks.



You should be able to:



* Understand invoices, bills, receipts, quotes, statements, and payment reminders.

* Identify invoice due dates, overdue balances, supplier payment terms, and outstanding amounts.

* Understand the difference between paid, unpaid, overdue, and partially paid invoices.

* Request missing invoices, receipts, tax invoices, and supplier statements.

* Identify GST on Australian tax invoices where applicable.

* Match payments to invoices or receipts where possible.

* Assist with basic expense tracking.

* Keep payment records organised for bookkeeping purposes.

* Prepare weekly summaries of bills due and payments made.

* Communicate with suppliers about payment arrangements and remittance advice.

* Flag duplicate invoices, incorrect bank details, suspicious
s, or unusual payment requests.

* Maintain simple spreadsheets for payments, expenses, supplier accounts, and cash flow tracking.



You do not need to be a qualified accountant, but you must be comfortable with basic financial administration and keeping records properly organised.



Drafting
s and Business Communications



You will assist with drafting:



* Supplier
s.

* Client follow-up
s.

* Payment arrangement
s.

* Recruitment
s.

* Meeting requests.

* Internal staff notices.

* General business correspondence.

* Responses to reminders, complaints, and outstanding matters.



Important
s must be submitted for approval before sending unless permission is given.



Daily Administration and Task Management



You will assist with:



* Preparing daily task lists.

* Reminding management of urgent deadlines.

* Updating task trackers.

* Coordinating meetings and appointments.

* Organising documents and correspondence.

* Maintaining notes of conversations and follow-ups.

* Providing end-of-day summaries of completed and outstanding tasks.



Required Skills



The ideal candidate should have:



* Strong written English.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Good organisation and time management.

* Ability to work independently.

* Experience managing
s and business communications.

* Experience using WeChat or similar chat applications.

* Basic understanding of invoices, payments, receipts, and supplier statements.

* Ability to draft clear and professional
s.

* Ability to prioritise urgent matters.

* Ability to follow instructions while also using initiative.

* High level of confidentiality and professionalism.



Preferred Skills



The following skills are preferred but not essential:



* Experience working with Australian businesses.

* Experience in bookkeeping, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or administration.

* Basic knowledge of Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, or similar accounting software.

* Experience using Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Dropbox, WhatsApp, WeChat, Slack, or task management tools.

* Mandarin, Cantonese, Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese, or other language skills.

* Experience supporting business owners, directors, executives, accountants, hospitality businesses, ecommerce businesses, or retail operations.



Confidentiality Requirement



This role involves access to sensitive business information, including
s, invoices, supplier details, client information, payment records, and internal communications.



The successful candidate must:



* Keep all information strictly confidential.

* Not share business information with any third party.

* Use secure devices and internet access.

* Not download, copy, or store confidential information outside approved systems.

* Report suspicious
s, unusual payment requests, or security concerns immediately.

* Be willing to sign a confidentiality agreement or NDA before commencing work.



Daily Reporting Requirement



At the end of each working day, you will provide a short daily report including:



* Urgent
s received.

* Important WeChat or chat messages.

* Payments due today or this week.

*
s drafted.

* Follow-ups completed.

* Outstanding tasks.

* Matters requiring management approval.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is trustworthy, organised, reliable, and proactive.



The right person will not only wait for instructions, but will also identify issues, remind management of deadlines, follow up important matters, and suggest practical ways to improve daily communication and administration.



This role would suit someone who enjoys being the organised support person behind a busy business owner and is comfortable working across multiple businesses and industries.



Employment Type



Remote / Virtual Assistant role

Part-time or full-time depending on experience and availability

Ongoing role available for the right candidate

Initial trial period: 2 to 4 weeks



Application Requirements



To apply, please provide:



* Your resume or work history.

* A short introduction about yourself.

* Details of your previous virtual assistant, administration, or accounting admin experience.

* Your availability and preferred working hours.

* Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate.

* Your experience with WeChat,
 management, spreadsheets, and accounting software.

* Your internet and computer setup.

* Any language skills.

* References or previous employer details, if available.



Trial Task



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short trial task, such as:



* Drafting a supplier follow-up
.

* Summarising sample
s.

* Preparing a simple payment reminder list.

* Drafting a response to a WeChat business message.

* Creating a daily task report.



Why Join Us?



This is a practical and important support role with the opportunity to work closely with a growing business group across multiple industries.



The successful candidate will have the chance to develop long-term involvement in business operations, communications, administration, supplier management, and finance support.



We are looking for someone who wants to be trusted, valued, and relied upon as part of the daily operations of the business.



This version is more attractive for candidates while still clearly setting expectations around
s, WeChat, payments, basic accounting, confidentiality, and autonomy.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER (GHL SPECIALIST)

Go Ignite  |  Fully Remote  |  Monday-Friday  |  7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

PHP 80,000/month + OTE  |  Prepaid HMO  |  Paid Time Off



If you can build a full GHL white label environment from scratch, run paid ads that convert, and own results end-to-end -- read on. 



If you have never led a team, need hand-holding, prefer to execute someone else's strategy, or are not ready to commit to a full 8-hour day with an international team -- this role is not for you.



Go Ignite is hiring one person for this role. We are not filling a seat. We are building our internal digital engine, and we need someone who has done this before at a high level.



This role is NOT for you if:

You have only used GHL as an end-user - proven sub-account builds, white label setups, and A2P/10DLC experience are required

You have never managed paid campaigns for Australian or US-based clients

You cannot show us real outcomes: funnels you built, ads you ran, metrics that moved

You are looking for someone to tell you what to do every day

You have never led, coordinated, or managed a marketing team or direct reports

 

About Go Ignite

Go Ignite is the growth and technology division of a specialist international recruitment group connecting top Filipino talent with high-growth Australian and US businesses. We build the systems -- the funnels, automations, and campaigns - that power candidate attraction and client conversion at scale. This is an internal hire. You will own the tools that drive the business.



The Role

You will lead the Go Ignite marketing function. The marketing team reports directly to you, giving leadership full visibility without day-to-day involvement. You own the GHL ecosystem, drive paid campaign performance, and set the standard for how the team executes and grows. This is a player-coach role -- you build, you lead, and you are accountable for results.



These are the five areas you will own:



Team Leadership & Direction

Lead and coordinate the Go Ignite marketing team -- you are the go-to for direction, prioritisation, and performance

Set weekly priorities, run team check-ins, and ensure campaigns and systems are moving without requiring escalation to the owner

Build and maintain SOPs so the team operates to a consistent standard and scales without bottlenecks

Report to the business owner on team performance, key wins, and strategic recommendations.



GHL Systems & Automation

Full white label environment management: sub-account setup, affiliate manager configuration, A2P/10DLC registration and compliance

Build and maintain lead generation funnels, automation workflows, nurture sequences, appointment booking flows, and CRM pipelines from scratch

Provide technical support and troubleshoot across workflows, deliverability, domains, and third-party integrations

Develop SOPs and documentation so systems scale without you as a single point of failure.



Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta 
/Instagram), Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube -- ad creatives and copy are supplied by the team

A/B test audiences, landing pages, and ad sets using performance data and AI-driven insights

Manage CPL, ROAS, and conversion targets across Australian and US market campaigns



Web, Integrations & Landing Pages

Maintain WordPress sites: forms, tracking pixels, domain configuration, webhooks, Zapier integrations

Build high-converting landing pages that support campaign objectives



Analytics, Reporting & Social

Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports across GHL dashboards, Google Analytics, and ad platforms

Support social media content scheduling and brand presence using AI tools and content calendars

Recommend improvements across funnels, paid ads, and
/SMS campaigns based on data. 



What You Must Bring

3+ years hands-on experience as a GHL Specialist or Digital Marketer -- not as a VA who uses GHL, but as someone who builds in it

Proven full white label GHL setup experience: sub-account creation, affiliate manager config, A2P/10DLC registration

Demonstrated paid ads results on Meta and/or Google Ads for Australian or US clients -- you have screenshots, ROAS data, or client outcomes to show us

WordPress integration skills: pixels, tracking, domains, webhooks, Zapier

Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, or similar) for content and automation tasks

Excellent written and spoken English -- you communicate directly with an international team daily

Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating a marketing team -- you know how to set direction, give feedback, and drive accountability

Self-directed, organised, and able to manage multiple campaigns and people without daily supervision

 

Why This Role Stands Apart



Most GHL roles in the Philippines are VA-level: follow the SOP, raise a ticket, wait for approval. This is not that.

You own the GHL ecosystem -- architecture decisions are yours

You work directly with the leadership team, not through layers of management

You see the full picture: how funnels feed ads, how ads feed the pipeline, how the pipeline drives revenue

You lead the marketing team -- this is a genuine step into a Head of Marketing function

International exposure with Australian and US market campaigns -- resume-building work with real accountability 

Compensation & Benefits



PHP 80,000/month base + OTE

Base salary: PHP 80,000/month. On-target earnings (OTE) are payable on top of base, tied to agreed performance outcomes. Total compensation for a strong performer exceeds base.

Prepaid HMO (ask us about dependent coverage options)

Paid Time Off

Fully remote -- work from anywhere in the Philippines

Full-time, 40 hours/week | Monday-Friday | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

Direct access to leadership and real career growth as the business scales



How to Apply

We review every application personally. We do not shortlist candidates who skip these steps.

1. Your updated CV

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction: who you are, why this role is the right next step, and a walkthrough of one GHL build you are proud of

3. Your portfolio -- funnels, automations, ad campaign results,
 sequences -- anything with measurable outcomes (Google Drive, Notion, or Loom links are fine).

title: YOUTUBE STRATEGIST/ CHANNEL MANAGER
description:
Market Leaders' socials - study before applying:


 




 



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most "YouTube manager" roles are upload monkeys. You're handed a finished video, you slap on a title someone else wrote, you publish, you log off.



Market Leaders doesn't work that way.



We have the cameras, the editors, and the founders who know the material cold. What we don't have is one person who owns the **thinking** — the person who d
 what we make, why anyone would click, and whether the channel actually grows.



That's you.



You are not here to edit. You are here to run the engine. You plan the slate with the team, you brief the people who shoot and edit, you write the titles and direct the thumbnails that d
 whether a video lives or dies, and you read the analytics like a scoreboard.



If you've grown a channel before and you think in CTR, retention, and packaging — not just in pretty cuts — read on.



This is a fully remote role for someone who wants to own a number, not wait for instructions.



ABOUT MARKET LEADERS



Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators — property agents doing $500M+ in deals, financial advisors with established ad systems, business owners building real personal brands — turn their expertise into content that compounds.



We teach the 5 C's: Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client. We believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable. World-class, no compromise.



This role is for **our own channels** — the Market Leaders brand channel plus our founders' long-form. You're building the flagship that proves what we teach. The bar is set.



TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE



**Base Salary:** SGD $2,000/month



**What's Included**

- Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT)

- Direct line to the founders and the content team you'll be directing

- Market Leaders training on hooks, packaging, retention, and short-form/long-form strategy

- The tools you need to do the job (analytics, scheduling, thumbnail collaboration, AI ideation)

- Ownership of a real channel's growth number — not a faceless task queue



**Work Benefits**

- Results-focused, not clock-watching — we judge the channel's numbers, not your hours online

- Clear monthly scoreboard so you always know where you stand

- Real budget exposure: your packaging gets tested with real distribution



**Path Forward**

- Prove you can grow the number, and the scope grows with you — more channels, a bigger team to direct, and a senior content-lead track

- This is a long-term seat for the right operator, not a gig

THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN



### 1. ROLE — The Mission



Own Market Leaders' long-form YouTube engine end to end.



You plan what we make, you direct the team that films and edits it, you package it so people click and stay, and you grow the channel on the strength of the analytics. You are the brain of the operation — the editors are the hands.



Every video serves a business objective:

- Position Market Leaders and our founders as the trusted authority in their space

- Earn the click (title + thumbnail) and hold the watch (structure + pacing)

- Turn our frameworks and founder insight into long-form people actually finish

- Feed the short-form machine — every long-form becomes Shorts and cross-platform clips



You will use AI to ideate and research faster, but the taste and the calls are yours.



### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work



**Strategy & Ideation — 30%**

- Plan the monthly long-form slate *with the team* — what we make, in what order, and why

- Research topics, search demand, and competitor channels to find angles worth filming

- Turn founder material and frameworks into clear briefs and outlines the team can shoot

- Bring a point of view to every video: who it's for, the hook, the payoff



**Packaging — Titles & Thumbnails — 25%**

- Write multiple title options per video and test them — this is the single biggest CTR lever

- Direct thumbnail concepts (brief the designer; you own the concept, not the Photoshop)

- Own click-through rate as a metric you're personally accountable for

- Keep a swipe file of what's working and feed it back into the next slate



**Production Direction — 25%**

- Brief the shooters and editors against your outline, then QC the cut against the brief

- Run the content calendar and pipeline so videos ship on a predictable cadence

- Unblock the team, chase what's stuck, and keep the machine moving

- Maintain a repeatable production system, not one-off heroics



**Channel Management & Analytics — 20%**

- Publish with proper titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, end-screens, and playlists

- Live in YouTube Studio: read CTR, average view duration, retention curves, and traffic sources

- Turn each long-form into Shorts and repurpose across Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn

- Report the numbers and the next move — what we'll change and why



### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like



**Foundation Phase — Month 1**

- Know the channels, the founders' voices, and the back catalogue cold

- Ship the first slate you planned end to end — briefed, filmed, edited, packaged, published

- Stand up a working content calendar and a titles/thumbnails packaging system

- Establish the baseline: current CTR, AVD, and retention, so we know what we're improving



*This phase is about learning the brand, the material, and the team rhythm.*



**Growth Phase — Month 3**

- Hold a consistent publishing cadence with no missed weeks

- Show a measurable lift in CTR and/or average view duration vs. baseline

- Run a repeatable packaging system the team can follow without you in every detail

- Reliably turn each long-form into Shorts and cross-platform clips



*This phase is where you stop reacting and start driving the channel.*



**Long-Term Impact — Month 6**

- Own the channel number — views, subscribers, retention — with minimal founder input

- Direct the team to ship the slate on cadence while you stay focused on strategy + packaging

- Demonstrate channel growth attributable to your packaging and slate decisions

- Be trusted to take on more channels and a bigger team



*This phase is where the channel runs as a system you own, not a series of one-offs.*



### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves



**Experience**

- Demonstrable track record growing a YouTube channel (yours or a client's) — show the before/after

- Hands-on experience writing and testing titles and directing thumbnails for CTR

- Experience directing a remote content team (editors, designers, shooters) against briefs

- Strong grasp of long-form structure, hooks, and retention — and how Shorts feed the main channel



**Skills**

- Fluent in YouTube Studio analytics — CTR, AVD, retention, traffic sources, and what to do about each

- Comfortable using AI tools for ideation, research, scripting support, and repurposing

- Strong written and spoken English — you'll be briefing a team and the founders daily

- Comfortable with a project-management tool (Notion, Asana, ClickUp, or similar)



**Work Arrangement**

- Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for briefs and reviews

- Reliable laptop and internet — you run the pipeline, you can't drop offline

- Able to commit long-term, not a short gig between other things



**Work Style**

- Ownership mentality — you treat the channel's growth like your own business

- Self-managed — nobody is going to watch over your shoulder; the numbers do that

- Decisive on packaging — you form opinions and test them, you don't wait to be told

- Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "this missed" than "this is fine"



WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT



**You Think in Numbers, Not Just Aesthetics**

You don't ask "is the video done?" You ask "will this title earn the click, and will the first 30 seconds keep them?" CTR and retention are your scoreboard.



**You've Actually Grown a Channel**

You can point to a channel you moved — views, subs, watch time — and explain *why* it grew. You know the difference between a video that got lucky and a system that compounds.



**You Direct Without Doing It All Yourself**

You're comfortable handing the camera and the timeline to the team and getting what you wanted through a clear brief and honest QC. You scale through people, not through your own keyboard.



**You Live in the Packaging**

You have opinions on titles and thumbnails. You can look at any channel and explain what you'd change to lift the click. You collect what works.



**You Use AI to Move Faster**

You're not scared of AI. You use it to research, ideate, and repurpose faster — and you know it sharpens your taste, it doesn't replace it.



**You Communicate Proactively**

A remote team only works if you flag things early. If footage is weak, you say so. If the slate's slipping, you raise it before it's a problem.



**You Crave Improvement**

You don't take a flat video personally. You read the retention graph, find the drop-off, and fix it next time.

HOW TO APPLY



**1.
**

Send your application to: 

Subject line: **YouTube Strategist — [Your Name]**



**2. Include These 3 Things**



**Channel Proof**

- Link to a YouTube channel you've grown or managed, with rough before/after numbers (views, subs, watch time)

- 2-3 examples of titles + thumbnails you packaged, and what the CTR did

- Optional but useful: an example where you used AI in your workflow



**Brief Response — 4 to 6 Sentences**



> *"Pick one YouTube channel in the business, finance, property, or coaching space that you think is packaged well. Name 3 things they do well that most channels in their niche do badly — and 1 thing you would change about their titles or thumbnails to lift the click. Be specific. Point to actual videos."*



This is the most important part of your application. We're hiring for strategic thinking, not just upload skills. Generic feedback = skipped application.



**Resume/CV**

PDF format only.



**3. Paid Trial — If Shortlisted**

We'll give you Market Leaders' positioning and one topic. You'll deliver a 30-day mini content plan:

- 5 long-form video concepts, each with 3 title options and a thumbnail direction

- One full video outline (hook ? structure ? payoff ? CTA)

- A short plan for repurposing that video into Shorts and cross-platform clips



- Turnaround: 72 hours from receipt of the brief

- Paid regardless of outcome



The trial isn't testing whether you can fill a template. It's testing whether you can think like a channel owner — pick angles that earn clicks, structure for retention, and run a system.



**4. Interview**

- 30-minute video call with the Market Leaders team

- A short live packaging exercise — we hand you a topic, you talk us through titles and thumbnail angles

- Decision before offer

title: Full-Time Outsourced Accounting Office Manager
description:
Full-Time Outsourced Accounting Office Manager



Philippines Growth Role | Recruitment | Office Setup | Accounting Operations Support | Long-Term Leadership Opportunity



We are seeking a highly motivated, organised, and business-minded individual to help build and manage a future outsourced accounting office in the Philippines.



This role is suitable for someone who wants more than a standard job. We are looking for a long-term manager who is eager to learn, grow, recruit staff, assist with office setup, manage daily operations, and help build a professional outsourced accounting team that services Australian businesses and accounting clients.



The successful candidate does not need to already have full knowledge of Australian taxation, SMSF administration, or SMSF audit. Training, guidance, and technical direction will be provided by Justin, the Australian principal, who has experience across accounting, audit, business advisory, hospitality, retail, and multi-business operations.



What is most important is that the candidate is trustworthy, proactive, willing to learn, business-minded, organised, and capable of helping build something from the ground up.



About the Opportunity



We are building an outsourced accounting and administration office in the Philippines to support Australian business operations and accounting services.



The business will aim to provide services including:



* Bookkeeping support.

* Accounts payable and accounts receivable support.

* Payroll administration support.

* BAS and GST preparation support.

* Client document collection.

* Australian accounting administration.

* SMSF administration support.

* SMSF audit support file preparation.

* Business administration support.

* Outsourced staffing support for Australian firms.



The successful candidate will work closely with Justin to help establish the team, find suitable staff, research office options, create systems, and support the growth of the Philippines office.



Key Purpose of the Role



The purpose of this role is to find a future leader who can assist with:



* Building an outsourced accounting team in the Philippines.

* Recruiting and training staff.

* Researching possible office locations.

* Helping establish office systems and workflows.

* Supporting daily business administration.

* Learning Australian accounting processes under guidance.

* Managing staff performance and communication.

* Helping grow the business into a larger outsourcing operation.



This is a long-term growth role with the opportunity to become a senior manager or Philippines office manager as the business expands.



Key Responsibilities



1. Recruitment and Team Building



The successful candidate will assist with:



* Finding suitable accounting, bookkeeping, administration, and virtual assistant candidates.

* Posting job advertisements.

* Reviewing resumes and applications.

* Shortlisting possible staff.

* Coordinating interviews.

* Assisting with trial tasks.

* Helping onboard new tea
mbers.

* Keeping recruitment records organised.

* Identifying future staffing needs as the business grows.



The candidate should be confident communicating with potential employees and helping build a reliable team culture.



2. Office Setup and Philippines Operations



The successful candidate will assist with researching and organising the setup of a Philippines-based office.



This may include:



* Researching suitable office locations.

* Finding possible office spaces, serviced offices, coworking offices, or small commercial offices.

* Comparing rental costs and office facilities.

* Contacting office providers or landlords.

* Preparing summaries of office options.

* Assisting with internet, computers, desks, security, and office setup requirements.

* Helping create a practical office environment for accounting and administration staff.



The candidate does not need to have previous office setup experience, but must be resourceful, organised, and willing to investigate options properly.



3. Learning Australian Accounting and Business Processes



The candidate does not need to already be an expert in Australian taxation, SMSF administration, or SMSF audit.



Justin will provide training, guidance, and direction.



However, the candidate must be willing to learn about:



* Australian bookkeeping.

* Australian GST and BAS basics.

* Payroll administration.

* Accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Client document collection.

* Accounting workflow management.

* SMSF administration support.

* SMSF audit support documentation.

* Business compliance administration.

* Client service standards.



The candidate must have a strong learning attitude and be comfortable gradually developing technical knowledge over time.



4. Daily Operations Management



The manager will assist with:



* Managing daily tasks and team workflow.

* Preparing daily and weekly task summaries.

* Following up staff on incomplete work.

* Keeping work organised and properly documented.

* Reporting progress to Justin.

* Identifying urgent issues.

* Maintaining task trackers.

* Creating workflow lists and checklists.

* Helping staff understand their responsibilities.

* Ensuring work is completed accurately and on time.



5. Business Growth and Development



We are seeking someone who has a genuine interest in business growth.



The successful candidate should be interested in learning how to:



* Build a team.

* Improve systems.

* Find new staff.

* Support client service delivery.

* Help create scalable business processes.

* Assist with marketing outsourced accounting services.

* Identify opportunities for improvement.

* Support long-term expansion of the office.

* Help create a professional and reliable outsourcing operation.



This role would suit someone who has ambition, initiative, and a desire to grow into a larger leadership role.



6. Communication and Reporting



The candidate must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with Justin, staff, candidates, suppliers, and potential office providers.



The role will require:



* Daily updates.

* Weekly progress reports.

* Recruitment summaries.

* Office space comparison summaries.

* Staff performance updates.

* Workflow updates.

* Issue reporting.

* Suggestions for improvement.



Clear written English is important.



7. Systems and Administration



The candidate will help create and manage simple systems, including:



* Recruitment trackers.

* Staff training records.

* Daily task lists.

* Weekly workflow reports.

* Office setup checklists.

* Staff performance notes.

* Accounting workflow checklists.

* Client document request lists.

* Internal procedure documents.



The candidate should be comfortable using spreadsheets,
, chat applications, online research, and cloud-based tools.



Accounting Knowledge Requirement



The candidate does not need to be a qualified accountant.



The candidate does not need to already know all Australian tax, SMSF, or audit rules.



However, the candidate should ideally have some basic understanding of accounting or business administration, such as:

* Receipts.

* Payments.

* Bank reconciliations.

* Bookkeeping basics.

* Payroll basics.

* Supplier statements.

* Accounts payable.

* Accounts receivable.

* Document organisation.

* Basic spreadsheet reporting.

Required Skills and Qualities



The ideal candidate should be:

* Reliable.

* Organised.

* Proactive.

* Willing to learn.

* Business-minded.

* Resourceful.

* A good communicator.

* Able to work independently.

* Able to follow instructions.

* Experience recruiting staff.

* Experience managing virtual assistants or junior staff.

* Experience working with Australian businesses.

* Experience in a BPO, outsourcing, or offshore staffing environment.

* Experience using Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or task management tools.

* Experience researching office spaces or helping set up business operations.

* Experience communicating with clients, suppliers, landlords, recruiters, or candidates.



Training Provided



Training and guidance will be provided by Justin.



The successful candidate will be trained in:



* Australian accounting workflow.

* Bookkeeping support processes.

* Document collection processes.

* SMSF administration support.

* SMSF audit support file preparation.

* Staff workflow management.

* Client service standards.

* Business operations.

* Office setup planning.

* Recruitment processes.

* Internal reporting systems.



The candidate must be willing to learn, take notes, improve, and help train future staff.



Confidentiality and Professional Standards



The successful candidate will have access to confidential business, client, accounting, payroll, and financial information.



The candidate must:



* Keep all information strictly confidential.

* Follow data security procedures.

* Use approved systems only.

* Not share business information with third parties.

* Maintain proper records.

* Report issues honestly and quickly.

* Be willing to sign a confidentiality agreement or NDA.



Long-Term Growth Opportunity



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person.



The goal is to build a full outsourced accounting office in the Philippines that can support Australian accounting firms, business clients, SMSF administration, bookkeeping, and audit support.



The successful candidate may grow into a senior role such as:



* Philippines Office Manager.

* Outsourced Accounting Team Manager.

* Operations Manager.

* Recruitment and Training Manager.

* Offshore Business Development Manager.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a career, not just complete daily tasks.



Employment Type



Full-time role

Remote initially, with the possibility of helping establish a physical Philippines office

Long-term role available for the right candidate

Initial trial period may apply

Growth pathway into senior management



Application Requirements



Applicants should provide:



* Resume or CV.

* Short introduction about yourself.

* Details of accounting, administration, recruitment, or business experience.

* Any experience working with Australian clients or businesses.

* Any experience managing staff or helping build a team.

* Any experience finding candidates or researching office spaces.

* Software experience.

* Expected monthly salary or rate.

* Availability and preferred working hours.

* Internet and computer setup if working remotely.

* References or previous employer details, if available.



Trial Task



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical trial task, such as:



* Finding 5 possible accounting staff candidates in the Philippines.

* Preparing a comparison of 3 possible office spaces.

* Creating a simple recruitment tracker.

* Drafting a staff onboarding checklist.

* Preparing a daily operations report.

* Reviewing a simple bookkeeping task and identifying what information is missing.



Ideal Candidate Summary



The ideal candidate is a reliable, proactive, and business-minded person who wants to help build an outsourced accounting office in the Philippines.



They do not need to already know everything about Australian accounting, SMSF, or taxation. These areas will be taught by Justin.



The most important qualities are honesty, loyalty, initiative, organisation, willingness to learn, ability to find and manage people, and the ambition to help grow a serious long-term business.



Thank you 

Jko Group
