title: Brand identity designer
description:
Brand Identity Designer Needed – Luxury Medical Aesthetics Relaunch

About Forever Young

Forever Young Laser Skin Rejuvenation is an established medical aesthetics clinic located in Edmonton, Alberta. For over 15 years, we have built our reputation through exceptional client care, advanced technology, and results-driven treatments. Today, we are proud to have over 1,600 five-star reviews and multiple industry and consumer awards.

As our business continues to evolve, we are undertaking a complete brand refinement and relaunch. While our reputation and success are well established, we feel our current branding no longer reflects the level of sophistication, innovation, and expertise we offer today.

Our website, social media platforms, marketing systems, and client-facing materials are currently in the design and redevelopment phase as part of this relaunch.

Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced brand designer to help develop a cohesive and elevated brand identity that will serve as the foundation for our relaunch and future growth.

This is not a startup brand. This is the evolution of a successful business that has spent 15 years building trust, results, and a loyal client base.

While our website and social media platforms are currently being redesigned, we believe the brand foundation must be established first. We are looking for a designer who can help define the visual identity that will guide all future touchpoints, including our website, social media, digital materials, in-clinic experience, advertising, and client education assets.

Who We Are

Forever Young is a comprehensive destination for advanced aesthetics, skin rejuvenation, beauty, and wellness.

Our services include:

Advanced Laser Skin Rejuvenation

RF Microneedling

Skin Tightening

Laser Hair Removal

Medical Facials

Chemical Peels

PRP Treatments

Injectables

Advanced Skin Consultations

Hair Services

Brows & Lashes

Nail Services

Advanced Foot Care

Waxing

Beauty Treatments

Unlike many clinics that focus on one specialty, we offer a complete aesthetics experience under one roof.

We have recently invested in some of the most advanced technologies available in the medical aesthetics industry and partner with leading medical-grade skincare brands including SkinCeuticals, ZO Skin Health, Vivier, EltaMD, and Colorescience.

Our Philosophy

Our clinic philosophy is built around:

Skin health

Skin longevity

Advanced diagnostics

Corrective treatments

Layered technologies

Long-term outcomes

We are not trend-driven. We are results-driven.

We want clients to feel confident that they are receiving expert recommendations backed by experience, technology, education, and proven results.

The Relaunch

This relaunch represents the next chapter of Forever Young.

Over the past year we have invested heavily in new technologies, treatment protocols, education, skincare partnerships, systems, and the overall patient experience.

As part of this relaunch we are rebuilding:

Website

Social Media Presence

Brand Identity

Digital Service Guides

 Marketing

Client Education Materials

In-Clinic Signage

Marketing Assets

Promotional Materials

Consultation Resources

Before these pieces are finalized, we want to ensure the brand foundation is strong, intentional, and aligned across all channels.

Brand Positioning

We want our brand to communicate:

Established and trusted

Results-driven

Technology-focused

Medical and professional

Luxurious yet approachable

Sophisticated

Modern

Timeless

Innovative

Educational

We are looking for a visual identity that reflects a premiu
dical aesthetics experience rather than a traditional spa environment.

Visual Direction

We are drawn to brands that feel:

Clean

Minimal

Elevated

Editorial

Modern Medical

Refined

High-End

We prefer:

Neutral colour palettes

Strong typography

Thoughtful use of white space

Premium layouts

Technology-focused visuals

Real clinic imagery

We want to avoid:

Generic spa branding

Overly feminine aesthetics

Trend-driven visuals

Excessive stock photography

Designs that feel dated or overly decorative

Scope of Work

We are looking for support with:

Brand Foundation

Logo refinement or redesign

Visual identity system

Colour palette

Typography selection

Brand guidelines

Graphic elements

Iconography

Marketing Assets

Social media templates

 templates

Presentation templates

Digital brochures

Service guides

Print collateral

Client Experience Materials

Signage

Consultation materials

Educational resources

In-clinic brand applications

Long-Term Vision

We are not looking for a one-time logo project.

We are looking for a creative partner who can help shape the future of our brand and create a scalable identity system that can grow with us as we continue to expand our technologies, services, marketing initiatives, and client experience.

The successful designer will understand how to blend luxury aesthetics, clinical credibility, modern marketing, and strong brand storytelling into one cohesive visual identity.

Submission Requirements

Please include:

A brief introduction about yourself

Relevant experience

Examples of similar branding projects

Luxury, wellness, medical, hospitality, or beauty work

Your proposed approach to this project

Estimated timeline

Pricing estimate

Deliverables included in your proposal

Any ongoing design support or retainer options available

Please also share any recommendations you feel would strengthen the Forever Young relaunch beyond the scope outlined above.

We are looking for someone who understands branding at a strategic level and can help create a memorable, recognizable, and sophisticated brand experience that reflects 15 years of trust, innovation, expertise, and exceptional client care.

title: Realtor Bookkeeper, TC and Social Media
description:

Pendergraft Realty | Part-Time (20 hrs/week), possible Full-Time | Long-Term | Weekends Required



About Us

We are a growing real estate team based in the United States. We work hard for our clients and take pride in delivering a professional, personal experience from the first showing to the closing table. We're looking for a reliable, skilled Virtual Assistant to become a key part of our daily operations — someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates proactively, and grows with us long-term.



We treat our team members with respect, pay on time, and value loyalty. If you're looking for a stable, long-term role where your contributions are genuinely appreciated, this is the right opportunity for you.



What You'll Do

This is a multi-skilled role. We need someone who can handle several areas of our business, not just one. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:



Bookkeeping





Manage bookkeeping tasks using QuickBooks or Simplify by Quicken Business and Personal(recording transactions, tracking expenses, reconciling accounts)

Maintain accurate financial records and assist with data entry

Provide general administrative support as needed





Social Media Management

Create, schedule, and publish content on
 and other social platforms

Develop engaging posts for property listings, team news, and community content

Monitor comments and respond to basic inquiries



Marketing Content

Create and post daily marketing content including home anniversaries, client appreciation posts, property highlights, team announcements, and seasonal content

Design graphics using Adobe or Canva for social media and marketing materials

Assist with content planning and scheduling



Video Content

Edit and organize property walkthrough videos

Create short-form video content optimized for social media

Ensure all video content is properly formatted for each platform



Website Management

Make updates to our WordPress website including property listings, blog posts, and general content

Maintain accuracy and functionality of the site



Transaction Coordination Support

Assist with organizing transaction files from contract to closing

Follow up with clients, agents, lenders, and title companies

Track deadlines and help keep transactions on schedule

Maintain organized digital documentation



What We're Looking For



Required:

At least 1–2 years of experience with QuickBooks or similar bookkeeping software

Proven experience managing
 and social media accounts for a business

Proficiency in Adobe or Canva for graphic design and content creation

Experience with WordPress (creating, updating content, listings, basic edits)

Basic video editing skills

Strong written English communication

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines without being micromanaged

Available to work weekends (this is required, not optional)



Preferred:

Real estate industry experience (U.S. market knowledge is a big plus)

Transaction coordination experience

Experience supporting a U.S.-based business or client



Schedule & Compensation

Hours: 20 hours per week to start, with potential to grow to full-time

Schedule: Must include weekend availability (Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday)

Pay: $550 & up USD/month depending on experience and skills

Setup: Work from home — you must have a reliable internet connection, a working computer, and a quiet workspace

Start Date: As soon as the right person is found
